steps.text: Run a live Postgres write burst via holo backup:wal --json — WAL archives to R2 continuously, zero continuity gaps (status=success, continuityOk, R2 growth, writeBurstRows≥1); pipeline health proven by overall: OK (not the unrelated pg_stat_archiver failed counter).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02 .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:wal --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; jq -e '.status=="success" and .ok==true and .continuityOk==true and .r2WalObjectCountAfter > .r2WalObjectCountBefore and .writeBurstRows >= 1 and .heartbeat.status=="success" and (.heartbeat.last_success_at != null)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.status=="failed" or .ok==false or .continuityOk==false or .writeBurstRows < 1 or (.r2WalObjectCountAfter <= .r2WalObjectCountBefore)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:status > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt || true; cp .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-03/backup-status-after-wal.txt; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; grep -qE 'overall:[[:space:]]+OK' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; ! grep -qE 'overall:[[:space:]]+FAILED' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(OK|status=success)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; ! grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(FAILED|OVERDUE)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt

steps.text: Run the scheduled base-backup job — full backup lands in the R2 bucket, verified by manifest.
Run the restic blob-mirror job — every local/remote object SHA-256 matches.
Kill the backup job mid-archive — alert fires within 15 minutes, no dashboard-polling needed.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode kill --job wal_archive --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and (.induction.real_process_killed==true or .induction.production_catch==true) and .heartbeat.status=="failed"' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.induction.path=="synthetic_poison" and .induction.real_process_killed!=true' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep

steps.text: Let the bucket credential expire in a test fixture — alert fires, not a silent failure.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode credential-expired --job base_backup --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and (.induction.real_auth_fault==true or .induction.production_catch==true) and .heartbeat.status=="failed"' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep

steps.text: Remove the backup config entirely — the alert still fires as overdue, never a false-healthy state.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode config-removed --job restic_blob_mirror --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and .induction.config_removed==true and .induction.config_exists_after==false' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep

steps.text: Execute D04-01 RED integration suite (sprint27-backup-alerting-red.test.ts) under PLATFORM_IT=1 with short alert windows — healthy silence + three failure modes against a real http.Server; dual-write transcript and webhook captures into .gate-evidence.
steps.literal_cmd: set -eu; RUN_ID="${GATE_RUN_ID:-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}"; SPRINT_DIR=".spec/prds/mk6-migration/tasks/sprint-27-standing-off-mini-backup-pipeline-and-alerting"; EVIDENCE="${SPRINT_DIR}/.gate-evidence/${RUN_ID}"; mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE/red-suite"; set +e; PLATFORM_IT=1 BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS=1000 BACKUP_ALERT_TEST_WINDOW_MS=10000 pnpm vitest run services/platform/tests/integration/sprint27-backup-alerting-red.test.ts >"$EVIDENCE/red-suite-transcript.log" 2>&1; ec=$?; set -e; cat "$EVIDENCE/red-suite-transcript.log"; cp "$EVIDENCE/red-suite-transcript.log" "$EVIDENCE/step7-d04-01-red-suite.log"; if [ -d .tmp/D04-01 ]; then cp -R .tmp/D04-01/. "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/"; fi; test "$ec" -eq 0; grep -Eiq '[1-9][0-9]* passed' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite-transcript.log"; test -f "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-posts.json"; jq -e '.postCount==0' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-posts.json" >/dev/null; ls "$EVIDENCE/red-suite"/failure-*-alert.json >/dev/null; echo D04_01_RED_SUITE_GATE_OK exit=$ec evidence=$EVIDENCE
